about: The event history of the demo. Written for it, not recorded: a few days of a board as its history tells them, with the firmware's own wording (the texts of eventAdd in the sources). scripts/build_demo.py puts it in place of the recorded history. A boot starts 'started' seconds before now; the last one has none: it started when the recorded board did. An event is [seconds after its boot, text], or with a negative time, seconds before the next boot; the line 'Boot #n: reason, firmware' is added in front of each boot. {fw} is the demo's version and {old} the one before; {bssid}, {channel}, {ip}, {broker} and {board} come from the recording. A board keeps 24 events: the 24 newest are shown.
